notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody.  I am the director of Insectoid Descent.  The project has been running smoothly.  There are now grenades, with 
+ 8 grenade types, 
+ The plazma gun with an adjustable setting, allowing 12 types of plazma bolts, 
+ The rocket launcher, with 3 rocket types
+ Increased colorful effects for various impacts (including more splatter)
+ Adjusted 7.62 penetration, allowing for some bullets to pass through
+ Experimenting with footstep sounds
+ Added a trading minigame that will allow you to profit from market fluctuations
+ Added a "funds" resource which will be used for weapon upgrades and hiring personnel
+ Dozens of small improvements to various aspects of the game
+ Redesigned the Main Menu to be more visually engaging and awesome

notes.title: Sprint Update 1.15 on the way!
notes.notes:
[b]Sprint Update 1.15[/b]

Last week we've added the sprint feature, (press left shift), and Sprint Shots, which are essentially health potions but for sprint instead of health.

[b]Developer Log - Insectoid Descent Date: July 1, 2024 This Week In Dev[/b]

[u]Spawn Locations[/u]: adjusted player spawn locations throughout the 6 levels. Player spawns are on the opposite ends of the exit hatch, which they must enter to proceed to the next level.

[u]Mini Gun Location[/u]s: Relocated the minigun locations in a few levels to make it harder to find. This is meant to reward exploration, and to receive a beneficial power-up even when you went down the wrong ventilation shaft.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536639/f65edfc4fb3dcd8f07c7b9ac16b210da92e57661.png[/img]

[u]Texture Overlapping[/u]: Resolved several issues where environmental textures were overlapping incorrectly, and various objects were oddly out of place.

[u]Cutscene Collaboration[/u]: Working with Clayton, our storyboard and character artist. He is creating the first drafts for the introductory cut scene. We’re aiming for a comic book style animated sequence, and Clayton is taking inspiration from Metal Gear Solid Peace Walker comic style cutscenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536639/3354c03ebd0339a2f2ebfd8178e1ae0c79e9739c.png[/img]

[u]Quit to Menu Button[/u]: I am creating an in-game live action menu with a “Quit” button, which will close the game, and a “Return to Main Menu” button. This is in contrast to the Pause menu, where the entire game is stopped. The live action menu will not pause the game.

Plans for The Game With 6 maps currently, we intend on having 12 full maps to play during the Scream Fest 2024. There will be more maps created afterwards, with a goal of 24 maps by the end of the year.

-Director of Insectoid Descent
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536639/10274c32ca17920182cb037350e9dc8d0e136228.png[/img]
